name: Getting Started
description: Essential setup guides to start sending automated campaigns with Growixa.

articles.title: Domain Verification, SPF & DKIM Setup
articles.excerpt: Configure DNS records to achieve 99%+ email inbox delivery and protect your brand domain reputation.

sections.title: Why DNS Authentication is Critical
sections.content: Major email providers like Gmail, Yahoo, and Outlook enforce strict SPF, DKIM, and DMARC authentication policies. Unauthenticated emails are frequently routed to the spam folder or rejected entirely.

sections.title: Required DNS Records
sections.content:
Add the following authentication records at your DNS host (Cloudflare, GoDaddy, Namecheap, Route53):

- **SPF (TXT)**: `v=spf1 include:spf.mtasv.net ~all` (when using Postmark) or your mail provider's SPF include record.
- **DKIM (CNAME or TXT)**: Add the DKIM public key records generated by your email delivery provider (such as Postmark or your mail provider).
- **DMARC (TXT)**: `v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@yourdomain.com` at `_dmarc.yourdomain.com` to monitor deliverability.

articles.title: Quickstart: Launch Your First Campaign in 5 Minutes
articles.excerpt: A step-by-step walkthrough to import contacts, configure sender identity, and schedule your first email blast.

sections.title: Step 1: Add Your Contacts
sections.content: Navigate to **Audience > Contacts** in your dashboard. You can add individual contacts manually or click **Import Contacts** to upload a CSV file. Growixa automatically validates email formats and maps custom fields like First Name, Company, and Phone.

sections.title: Step 2: Connect a Sender Identity
sections.content: Go to **Settings > Integrations**. Connect a **Postmark** API token or your **Custom SMTP / Amazon SES** credentials. Ensure you have added your verified sender email (e.g. `newsletter@yourcompany.com`).

sections.title: Step 3: Build & Launch Your Campaign
sections.content:
Head to **Campaigns > + New Campaign** to launch the 5-step campaign wizard:

1. **Setup**: Name your campaign and write a compelling subject line (or click **'✨ Ask AI'** for subject ideas).
2. **Audience**: Select 'All Contacts', a static list, or a dynamic segment.
3. **Template**: Choose a pre-designed responsive template or write custom HTML/Markdown.
4. **AI Review**: Tune the tone, length, and call-to-action.
5. **Review & Send**: Choose **Send Now** for immediate delivery or **Schedule** for a future date and time.

articles.title: Welcome to Growixa & Core Concepts
articles.excerpt: Learn how Growixa combines contact management, AI content generation, and email automation into a single growth platform.

sections.title: What is Growixa?
sections.content: Growixa is an AI-powered marketing and customer engagement platform built for modern businesses, creators, and growth teams. It unifies high-deliverability email campaigns, intelligent audience segmentation, AI marketing copy generation with mandatory human approval, and multichannel automation into a fast, intuitive dashboard.

sections.title: The 3 Core Pillars
sections.content:
Growixa is structured around three foundational pillars that work seamlessly together:

1. **Audience & Contact Engine**: Manage contacts, custom attributes, static lists, dynamic real-time segments, and compliance-first suppression lists.
2. **AI Marketing Studio**: Generate engaging, high-converting subject lines, social posts, and email bodies with built-in human-in-the-loop safety.
3. **Campaign Delivery & Scheduling**: Build campaigns with a 5-step wizard, schedule sends, track delivery analytics, and route via Postmark or custom SMTP.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.content: To get started right away, follow our [Quickstart Guide](/docs/getting-started/quickstart) to add your audience, connect an email sender, and launch your first campaign in under 5 minutes.

name: Audience & Contacts
description: Manage subscribers, custom fields, dynamic segments, suppression lists, and contact lifecycle.

articles.title: Contact Lifecycle, Statuses & Archiving
articles.excerpt: Understand how active, archived, and suppressed statuses impact your audience targeting and quota limits.

sections.title: Contact Status Breakdown
sections.content:
- **Active**: Subscribed contacts eligible to receive marketing and broadcast campaigns. Only active contacts count against your account contact quota (`max_contacts`).
- **Archived**: Inactive contacts excluded from regular campaign dispatches while preserving historical campaign delivery metrics.
- **Suppressed**: Permanently blocked from receiving campaigns due to unsubscribes, spam complaints, or hard bounces.

sections.title: Archiving vs Managing Contacts
sections.content: Archiving allows you to remove inactive subscribers from your active campaigns and quota without losing past analytics and campaign engagement history.

articles.title: Contact Management & Custom Attributes
articles.excerpt: Learn how to view, search, tag, and attach custom metadata to your audience contacts.

sections.title: Viewing and Filtering Contacts
sections.content: The **Contacts Dashboard** (`/dashboard/contacts`) gives you a single overview of your entire audience. You can filter by status (**All**, **Active**, **Archived**), search across names, emails, and sources, and paginate across large contact databases.

sections.title: Custom Field Attributes
sections.content: You can define flexible custom fields such as `company_name`, `plan_type`, `industry`, or `signup_date`. Custom fields can be populated during CSV imports or updated via API, and can be used directly in dynamic segment rules and email template personalization tags.

sections.title: Tagging Contacts
sections.content: Tags provide lightweight labels (e.g. `VIP`, `Webinar-2026`, `Beta-Tester`) to categorize contacts on the fly. You can attach multiple tags to any contact and filter campaigns accordingly.

articles.title: Importing Contacts via CSV & Field Mapping
articles.excerpt: How to prepare CSV files, map columns, handle duplicates, and inspect import error reports.

sections.title: Preparing Your CSV File
sections.content: Your CSV file should have a header row with columns like `email`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `phone`, and any custom fields. UTF-8 encoding is recommended.

sections.title: 3-Step Import Workflow
sections.content:
1. **Upload**: Drag and drop your `.csv` file in the Import Hub (`/dashboard/contacts/imports`).
2. **Map Columns**: Match your CSV header columns to Growixa contact fields (`Email`, `First Name`, `Last Name`, `Phone`, `Source`, `Custom Fields`).
3. **Process & Inspect**: Growixa processes rows in the background, updating existing contacts and flagging invalid rows with detailed error messages.

articles.title: Dynamic Rule-Based Segments vs Static Lists
articles.excerpt: Target the right audience with real-time dynamic segments and curated static lists.

sections.title: Dynamic Segments vs Static Lists
sections.content:
- **Dynamic Segments**: Automatically recalculate membership in real time based on filter rules (e.g. `status == 'ACTIVE'` AND `created_at > 30 days ago` AND `tag == 'VIP'`). As new contacts join or change attributes, they automatically enter or leave the segment.
- **Static Lists**: Fixed subscriber groups (e.g. 'Newsletter Subscribers May 2026') where members are added or removed manually.

sections.title: Supported Rule Operators
sections.content:
When building dynamic segments, you can combine rules using operators:

- `EQUALS` / `NOT_EQUALS`
- `CONTAINS` / `NOT_CONTAINS`
- `GREATER_THAN` / `LESS_THAN` (for numbers and dates)
- `IS_SET` / `IS_NOT_SET`

articles.title: Suppression Lists, Bounces & Consent Compliance
articles.excerpt: Comply with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and CASL regulations with automatic unsubscribe suppression and audit trails.

sections.title: How Suppression Works in Growixa
sections.content:
Growixa maintains an immutable suppression list per tenant. When an email is suppressed (via unsubscribe link, spam complaint, hard bounce, or manual addition):

1. It is permanently blocked from receiving campaign emails.
2. Even if the email is re-imported from a CSV, it remains suppressed.
3. Archiving a contact never removes their suppression status.

sections.title: Domain-Level Suppression
sections.content: You can also suppress entire domains (e.g. `@competitor.com` or `@disposable-inbox.net`) to prevent sending to specific organizations or temporary email services.

name: Campaigns & Email Marketing
description: Build responsive emails, schedule automated blasts, and track deliverability metrics.

articles.title: Campaign Analytics & Deliverability Metrics
articles.excerpt: Understand open rates, click-through rates (CTR), bounce classifications, and delivery logs.

sections.title: Understanding Your Metrics
sections.content:
- **Sent**: Total recipients queued and dispatched.
- **Delivered**: Messages confirmed received by destination mail servers.
- **Opens**: Total and unique open counts tracked via invisible tracking pixel.
- **Clicks**: Unique link clicks across email body CTAs.
- **Bounces**: Hard bounces (invalid mailbox) and soft bounces (mailbox full / temporary reject).

articles.title: 5-Step Campaign Creation Wizard
articles.excerpt: Walkthrough of the full campaign builder from subject line formulation to audience selection and delivery review.

sections.title: The 5 Steps Explained
sections.content:
1. **Campaign Setup**: Specify campaign name, from-address, reply-to, and subject line. Use **'✨ Ask AI'** to generate high-performing variations.
2. **Audience Selection**: Target your entire audience, specific contact lists, or targeted dynamic segments.
3. **Template & Content**: Choose responsive email templates or edit rich HTML copy.
4. **AI Optimization**: Fine-tune tone, urgency, and reading level.
5. **Review & Schedule**: Send a test email to your inbox, then choose immediate send or schedule for a future date.

articles.title: Campaign Scheduling, Queue Throttling & Cancellation
articles.excerpt: How Growixa schedules future sends, processes background queues, and allows cancelling queued jobs.

sections.title: Scheduling Future Campaigns
sections.content: You can schedule campaigns up to 1 year in advance in your local timezone. Scheduled campaigns appear under the **'Scheduled'** tab with countdown indicators.

sections.title: Cancelling a Scheduled Campaign
sections.content: As long as a campaign has not entered the active sending state, you can click **'Cancel Campaign'** to abort the scheduled send and return it to draft status.

name: AI Marketing Copilot
description: Generate high-converting marketing copy with mandatory human review safeguards.

articles.title: AI Marketing Studio & Multi-Variation Generation
articles.excerpt: Generate subject lines, social media captions, and email bodies tailored by tone, audience, and intent.

sections.title: The AI Copilot Studio
sections.content:
Located under `/dashboard/ai`, the AI Marketing Studio allows you to generate content across three primary formats:

1. **Subject Lines**: Punchy, high-open-rate subject ideas.
2. **Social Captions**: Optimized for Twitter, LinkedIn, and Instagram with hashtags.
3. **Email Bodies**: Full promotional announcements, newsletter blurbs, and product launch letters.

sections.title: Tuning AI Parameters
sections.content: Customize tone (Professional, Conversational, Urgent, Friendly), target audience description, and temperature to generate 3 distinct creative variations simultaneously.

articles.title: Human-in-the-Loop Review & Approval Safety
articles.excerpt: Growixa's core safety principle: AI content is always drafted for review and never sent autonomously.

sections.title: The Human-in-the-Loop Guarantee
sections.content: Growixa strictly enforces human approval for all AI outputs. The AI assistant functions as a creative accelerator, but every generated draft must be reviewed, edited, and explicitly approved by a team member before entering any campaign dispatch queue.

name: Integrations & SMTP
description: Connect email delivery providers and custom AI API credentials.

articles.title: Bring Your Own Key (OpenAI & Anthropic)
articles.excerpt: Use your own custom OpenAI GPT-4o or Anthropic Claude API keys for unlimited generation.

sections.title: Custom AI Provider Keys
sections.content: While Growixa provides platform AI credits out of the box, high-volume teams can configure their own OpenAI or Anthropic API keys under **Settings > Integrations > AI Providers** to eliminate rate limits.

articles.title: Connecting Postmark for Email Delivery
articles.excerpt: Configure Postmark Server API tokens and message streams for transaction and broadcast delivery.

sections.title: Configuring Postmark
sections.content:
1. Log into your Postmark account and copy your **Server API Token**.
2. In Growixa, navigate to **Settings > Integrations > Postmark**.
3. Paste the token and specify your default Broadcast Message Stream ID (`broadcast` or `outbound`).
4. Click **'Test Connection'** to verify credentials before saving.

articles.title: Custom SMTP & Mail Server Configuration
articles.excerpt: Connect any standard SMTP provider (for example Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailgun, or your own mail server).

sections.title: SMTP Parameters
sections.content:
- **Host**: SMTP server host (e.g. `email-smtp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com`).
- **Port**: Typically `587` (STARTTLS) or `465` (SSL/TLS).
- **Username & Password**: Mail authentication credentials.
- **Use TLS**: Check this box for encrypted transport.

name: Billing & Subscriptions
description: Manage subscription tiers, contact quotas, send limits, and Razorpay billing.

articles.title: Subscription Plans & Quota Limits
articles.excerpt: Understand how contact quotas (max_contacts) and email send allowances work across plan tiers.

sections.title: How Quotas Are Enforced
sections.content:
- **Active Contacts Quota**: Only contacts with `status == 'ACTIVE'` count toward your plan limit. Archived contacts do not consume quota.
- **Email Send Limits**: Monthly send allowances reset at each billing cycle rollover.
- **Real-Time Warning**: Reaching your quota prevents new contact creations with a clear upgrade prompt (`HTTP 402`).

articles.title: Upgrading Your Plan & Payment Methods
articles.excerpt: Upgrade to Starter, Growth, or Pro plans using international credit cards, net banking, or UPI.

sections.title: 1-Click Plan Upgrades
sections.content: Go to **Settings > Billing** (`/dashboard/billing`) to view your current usage, compare plan tiers, and upgrade instantly via Razorpay checkout with instant account quota elevation.
